expectations.text: Writes a validation report at docs/validation/002-due-dates.md following the report template.
expectations.evidence: Report present with Summary, Open findings, Coverage, Regression, Not verified, Observations, Closed findings.

expectations.text: Reports the business-rule boundary defect: a task due today is marked overdue (S6.2 / R4).
expectations.evidence: F1 in both runs, with the <= comparison in src/dates.js named.

expectations.text: Reports the UI defect: title and marking are 14 px on a phone instead of the required 20 px (QE5).
expectations.evidence: with_skill F4 measured with getComputedStyle at 390x844; baseline F4 measured at 375x812.

expectations.text: Reports that recurring tasks were built although 002 lists them as out of scope.
expectations.evidence: F3 in both runs: repeat field, 'Repeat weekly' checkbox, stored value.

expectations.text: Reports the 001 regression: done tasks no longer sorted below open ones (001 S3.2).
expectations.evidence: F2 in both runs; the 001 acceptance suite fails 1 of 11.

expectations.text: Raises no more than one finding outside the planted set.
expectations.evidence: One extra in each run: QE7, the add form wrapping on a phone, which is a direct consequence of the out-of-scope checkbox and is legitimate.

expectations.text: Derives the checks from the requirements instead of mirroring the implementation report's claims.
expectations.evidence: Both runs explicitly contradict the report's 'all passed' self-validation.

expectations.text: Adds black-box acceptance tests under tests/acceptance/002-due-dates/.
Actually starts the compose stack and reports evidence from the running product.
expectations.evidence: Both ran the stack, measured memory and latency, and tore it down.

expectations.text: Runs the 001 acceptance tests as a regression and reports the result.
expectations.evidence: with_skill 10/11; baseline 001 10 passed 1 failed, 002 13 passed 5 failed.

expectations.text: Every finding has numbered steps to reproduce, an Expected, an Actual and a severity.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 5 findings, each with numbered steps, Severity, Expected, Actual. Baseline: prose findings with code excerpts and failing test names, but no numbered steps and no Severity/Expected/Actual fields (0 matches).
git diff against the seed tip over src/, public/, Dockerfile, compose and package.json is empty in both runs.

expectations.text: Sets the requirements status to 'Changes requested – back to implementation' and gives that verdict.
expectations.evidence: with_skill: status set, verdict 'Changes requested'. Baseline: status left at 'Implemented – ready for validation', verdict written as 'Rejected – findings to fix', which is not one of the defined verdicts.

expectations.text: Asks the user no question in its final message.
